description: Collect all-time stats for one or more TikTok hashtags and/or the videos underneath them. Stats mode is the cheapest; feed mode returns the public US hashtag feed; search mode returns one page of keyword search; auto combines stats and feed and adds search when the feed is short.

hashtags.description: Hashtags to collect. Accepts a bare tag, #tag, or a TikTok tag URL. Case-insensitive, duplicates removed. Up to 10.
hashtags.title: Hashtags

includeStatsRow.description: Emit the aggregate hashtag stats row before video rows in feed, search and auto modes. Stats mode always emits it.
includeStatsRow.title: Include Stats Row

maxHashtags.description: Process no more than this many hashtags from the list (1–10). Extra hashtags are skipped.
maxHashtags.title: Max Hashtags

maxVideosPerHashtag.description: Upper bound on videos per hashtag for feed, search and auto modes (0–300). Use 0 for stats only. TikTok usually returns fewer than requested: the feed is served in pages of about 30 and many tags stop after roughly 100–150 rows.
maxVideosPerHashtag.title: Max Videos Per Hashtag

mode.description: What to collect. 'stats' returns one aggregate row per hashtag (cheapest). 'feed' returns the public hashtag video feed. 'search' returns one page of TikTok keyword/hashtag search results. 'auto' returns stats plus the feed and adds search results only when the feed is shorter than one page.
enumTitles: Stats only — video and view totals
Hashtag feed — videos under the tag
Search — one page of TikTok results
Auto — stats + feed, search when short
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the built-in US residential connection with automatic fallback. Set your own Apify proxy configuration here to override it. Feed mode uses the most residential bandwidth, which is billed by Apify proxy usage.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

region.description: Market used for the hashtag feed. Only the United States is verified to return a public feed; other markets are not exposed yet.
region.title: Region

title: TikTok Hashtag Stats and Video Feed Input
